question: Can I return unused, unopened headphones delivered 20 days ago? I have the original box and receipt.

retrieved_chunks.text:
# ShopLite - Returns Policy


Customers may request a change-of-mind return within 30 calendar days after delivery. The delivery date, not the order date, starts this window. Products must be unused, in their original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase. An unopened pair of headphones delivered 20 days ago is eligible if these conditions are met.

Opened personal-care products, downloaded digital products, and personalized items are not eligible for change-of-mind returns. Opened headphones that have been used and are not faulty are also not eligible. A change-of-mind request made 45 days after delivery is outside the return window.

Start a return from the Returns section of your ShopLite account. Approval is required before sending an item. For an approved change-of-mind return, the customer pays return shipping. Refund timing is described in the Refunds Policy.

An item that arrived damaged follows the separate Damaged Items Policy, even if its packaging has been opened. Do not apply the unused-item condition to an arrival-damage claim. The assistant cannot approve a return or access a customer's order.

# ShopLite - Refunds Policy


For approved returns, ShopLite inspects the returned item after it reaches the warehouse. Within 5 business days after a successful inspection, ShopLite issues a refund to the original payment method. The bank or payment provider may then take an additional 3 to 7 business days to display it. These are separate stages; do not promise that money will appear within 5 days of posting the return.

For a change-of-mind return, the original outbound shipping charge is not refunded and return shipping is paid by the customer. For an approved arrival-damage claim, the remedy and shipping costs follow the Damaged Items Policy.

The assistant can explain the general refund process but cannot see whether a specific return was received, inspected, approved, or refunded. It cannot issue a refund. For a transaction-specific update, the customer must contact support through the account's Help section.

# ShopLite - Damaged Items Policy

When an item arrives damaged, the customer must report the arrival damage within 7 calendar days after delivery. Submit the claim through the Help section of the ShopLite account and provide the order number, a photo of the damaged product, and a photo of the shipping packaging. Keep the item and packaging until support gives instructions.

Opening packaging to discover or document arrival damage does not make the claim ineligible. For example, an item delivered 3 days ago that was damaged on arrival can be reported even after its packaging was opened. Damage caused by the customer after delivery does not qualify as arrival damage.

For an approved arrival-damage claim, the customer may choose a replacement when available or a full refund including the original shipping charge. ShopLite supplies a prepaid return label if it requires the damaged product to be returned. Do not promise a replacement is in stock.

The assistant cannot assess photographs, approve a claim, issue a label, or initiate a refund. It only explains the policy and submission process.
